_source: Hand-made sample data (for an architecture demo). Rough values loosely based on the handedness and approximate production of nine real players; they are not official or exact numbers. Check the real values at the MLB Stats API (https://statsapi.mlb.com/) or Baseball Savant (https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/). This is a mixed sample lineup of players from various teams, not one team's actual batting order.
_format: The shape of the "raw data" that mlb_data_adapter.normalize_batter_record() reads. Column names are close to the MLB Stats API / Savant leaderboards (avg/obp/slg as is; whiff_pct, chase_pct, pull_pct, k_pct, bb_pct, gb_pct, speed_pct are 0-100 percentiles / percentages).
_zone_profile_note: If you add an optional "zone_profile": {location: number (higher = stronger)} to a player, hot_course / weak_course are computed from real data instead of a hunch rolled from the player's name (location names are the 9 keys of constants.COURSES. Example: {"out_lo": 0.12, "in_hi": 0.48}). It is not included in this sample -- tying Baseball Savant's per-zone results to real players needs verification against real data, which could not be done here. On a machine with network access, check Savant's Statcast hot / cold zones and add these keys yourself to make it real.
